rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading the page RENDERED FROM THE PDF ITSELF (CGPDFPage, mediaBox 792x612; THIS page is printed LANDSCAPE and needs no rotation, unlike page 12 and the appropriations pages which are printed sideways) at 6x and read in two crops. FY2011 carries NO text layer on any page -- pdfplumber.extract_words() returns 0 words on page 71 and the page holds one 4400x3400 CCITTFax bitmap (~400 dpi). No recognition was used: the OCR TSV for this edition was not consulted for any figure here.
rows.proof: `CAPITAL PROJECT FUNDS FY 2011`, PDF page 71 of the FY2011 annual town report (printed folio 68). ONE table, 34 figure rows under six article headings, against a printed `GRAND TOTAL` row. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, VERBATIM AND IN ORDER (rule 13b.4): `ART #/YR` | `PURPOSE` | `APPROPRIATED FORWARD` | `EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/ TRANSFERRED` | `BALANCE`. The `fwd` tokens printed to the right of the first money column are part of that column's label, not figures. WHAT PROVES IT, and there are two independent proofs: (1) all THREE money columns foot to the printed GRAND TOTAL to the cent and with no tolerance -- 2,561,789.31, 750,290.55 and 1,811,498.76; (2) every one of the 34 rows closes on the identity the table states about itself, appropriated forward less expended/encumbered/transferred equals balance. One wrong digit anywhere breaks both. THE SIGN CONVENTION IS THE DOCUMENT'S AND IS FIXED BY THE TOTAL: four rows print the expended cell in PARENTHESES -- ($744.00), ($5.00), ($590.80) and ($39.24) -- and are recorded negative. Read as positives the column would foot to 753,048.63 against a printed 750,290.55, so the printed total settles it rather than a convention we chose. ROWS ARE KEYED BY PRINTED POSITION, NOT BY NAME. `ENGINEER AND CONSTRUCT SEWERS` is printed twice, `COMPUTER REPLACEMENT PLAN - TECHNOLOGY DEPT.` four times and `POLICE CRUISERS - POLICE DEPT.` twice; keying on the name would collapse eight rows into four and the cells would overwrite each other. `fund_number` is the row's ordinal down the page, 01 to 34, and `fund_name` carries the article heading the row sits under followed by the printed purpose, so each key is unique on this page. A cell left blank in the expended column is recorded as no value at all, not as zero -- eleven rows print nothing there and their balance equals their appropriation.

rows.read_by: claude-opus-5, read off the page's OWN STORED BITMAP -- the single CCITTFaxDecode image each page of this report carries (4400x3400, 1-bit, ~400 dpi), pulled out with `stream.rawdata` wrapped in a single-strip TIFF header and decoded as GROUP 3 2-D, then turned 180 degrees and cropped into bands at FULL SCALE. NO recognition was used, and no re-render: pdfminer's get_data() RAISES on these streams, which under a try/except reads as a page with no picture.
rows.proof: `TRUST FUNDS`, PDF page 73 of the FY2011 annual town report (4117-fy-2011-annual-town-report.pdf), printed folio 70, `Page 1 of 2`; page 74 is Page 2 of 2. EVERY PAGE OF THIS REPORT IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 0 words -- so it was read off the page's own stored bitmap. THE PRINTED COLUMN HEADER, READ OFF THE PAGE AND WRITTEN DOWN (rule 13b.4): `FUND NAME` | `BEGINNING BALANCE PRINCIPAL` | `BEGINNNING BALANCE EARNINGS` | `CONTRIB TO PRINCIPAL` | `NET EARNINGS` | `DISBURSE FROM PRINCIPAL` | `TRANSFERS OF EARNINGS` | `ENDING CASH VALUE` | `UNREALIZED GAIN/LOSS` | `ENDING MARKET VALUE` -- the second is printed with THREE Ns, `BEGINNNING`, and is transcribed here as the page spells it. The same nine money columns and the same two identities FY2012 and FY2013 print. THE PAGE IS SHEARED AND THE SHEAR IS THE WHOLE DIFFICULTY. The bitmap is turned 180 degrees from upright, and within it the scan is rotated about 1 degree, so the label column and the right-hand figure columns drift apart by roughly a FULL ROW across the 4400px page width: PERPETUAL CARE BEQUEST's $174,667.24 prints on the C. ALLEN HEADSTONE line. NOTHING HERE WAS PAIRED BY EYE OR BY VERTICAL POSITION. Each column was read top-to-bottom as an ordered list within its section, and the label-to-figure pairing is the one the page's OWN ARITHMETIC accepts -- both row identities and all nine subtotals. A wrong pairing cannot make real arithmetic close (rule 13b). WHAT PROVES THIS GROUP: the CEMETERY FUNDS block's own printed SUBTOTAL closes in ALL NINE columns exactly, and every fund row closes on BOTH row identities the table states. No tolerance declared. CROSS-YEAR, AND IT IS A SECOND INSTRUMENT RATHER THAN A SECOND LOOK: this group's ending earnings (beginning_earnings + net_earnings) per fund -- 7,864.33 / 448.85 / 24,544.35 -- are exactly the BEGINNNING BALANCE EARNINGS the FY2012 report prints for the same three funds (sources/data/page-reads/fy2012-p73-trust-cemetery.csv), and this year's beginning principal 166,802.91 / 100.00 / 141,557.37 is FY2012's beginning principal, which is what a year with no contributions or disbursements must produce.
